title: Coniugātiō Praesentis Āctīvī
subtitle: Tempus praesēns modī indicātīvī, vōce āctīvā, verbōrum in -ω (ut λύω); īnfīnītīvus praesēns āctīvus.
objectives: Coniugāre plēnē tempus praesēns indicātīvī āctīvī verbī λύω (solvō, līberō) per omnēs persōnās, utrōque numerō
Recognōscere dēsinentiās persōnālēs āctīvās (-ω, -εις, -ει, -ομεν, -ετε, -ουσι) ut fundāmentum omnium temporum futūrōrum
Trānsferre sententiās simplicēs cum verbīs praesentis āctīvī, distinguendō ā fōrmīs iam nōtīs verbī εἰμί

content.intro: Ἀγάθων ἀπορίαν ἔχει. Τί λύεις; λέγει Μελίτη. Notāvistī: λύεις — fōrma nova, nōn εἰμί. Hodiē ad prīmam coniugātiōnem regulārem pervenīmus: maior pars verbōrum Graecōrum in dictiōnāriīs citātur fōrmā prīmae persōnae singulāris praesentis āctīvī indicātīvī, fīnīta -ω (nōn fōrmā īnfīnītīvī, sīcut in linguīs modernīs).
content.explanation:
Ἀγάθων ἀπορίαν ἔχει. Μελίτη λέγει· “Τί λύεις;” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ὁ διδάσκαλος λύει τὴν ἀπορίαν.” “Ἡμεῖς λύομεν τὰς πύλας,” λέγει Μελίτη. “Καὶ οἱ πολῖται βούλονται λύειν τὸν νόμον.” (Agathōn quaestiōnem habet. Melitē dīcit: “Quid solvis?” Agathōn dīcit: “Magister quaestiōnem solvit.” “Nōs portās solvimus/aperīmus,” dīcit Melitē. “Et cīvēs volunt lēgem solvere.”)

Notāvistīne λύεις, λύει, λύομεν, λύειν — eadem rādīx λυ-, dēsinentia dīversa secundum persōnam? Verbum Graecum indicat persōnam (1ª/2ª/3ª) et numerum (sg./pl.) per dēsinentiam ipsam, sīcut Latīnum — nūllum prōnōmen subiectī est necessārium (exāctē sīcut cum εἰμί, ex Gradū I). Paradigma λύω (“solvō, līberō”, verbum classicum citātiōnis in omnī grammaticā Graecā) exemplificat dēsinentiās praesentis āctīvī, quae — cum parvīs mūtātiōnibus — reapparent in omnī tempore futūrō āctīvō (imperfectō, futūrō) quod discēs in Gradibus sequentibus.

rules.heading: a) Praesēns Indicātīvum Āctīvum: λύω
rules.body:
PersōnaSingulārisPlūrālis
1ªλύωλύομεν
2ªλύειςλύετε
3ªλύειλύουσι(ν)

Comparā cum Latīnō: solvō, solvis, solvit, solvimus, solvitis, solvunt — structūra fundāmentāliter eadem (thema + dēsinentia persōnālis), sōlum fōrmae ipsae dīversae. Nōtā ν ephelkystikon in 3ª persōnā plūrālī (λύουσιν), ex Gradū I iam nōtum.

rules.heading: b) Īnfīnītīvus Praesēns Āctīvus
rules.body: Īnfīnītīvus praesēns āctīvus fīnītur -ειν: λύειν (“solvere, līberāre”). Adhibētur sīcut īnfīnītīvus Latīnus: post verba auxiliāria (βούλομαι λύειν “volō solvere”), vel in cōnstrūctiōnibus syntacticīs quās posteā vidēbis (ōrātiō oblīqua cum accūsātīvō + īnfīnītīvō, Gradū IV).

rules.heading: c) Thema Verbī et Dēsinentiae Persōnālēs
rules.body: Verbum Graecum cōnstat ex themate (radīx invariābilis, hīc λυ-) plūs dēsinentia persōnālis (-ω, -εις, -ει...). Vōcālis thematica (hīc, saepe -ο-/-ε- variāns secundum persōnam: λύομεν, λύετε) coniungit thema cum dēsinentiā — nōmen technicum “vōcālis thematica”, unde “coniugātiō thematica” (classis maior verbōrum, opposita paucīs verbīs āthemāticīs in -μι quae dēsinentiam addunt dīrēctē sine vōcālī iūnctīvā). Nunc sufficit recognōscere hanc structūram; theoria plēna verbōrum -μι sequitur in gradibus posteriōribus.

examples: λύω τὸν δοῦλον. — Solvō/līberō servum. (1ª sg., accūsātīvus obiectī)
ὁ διδάσκαλος λύει τὴν ἀπορίαν. — Magister solvit quaestiōnem/dubitātiōnem. (3ª sg.)
λύομεν τὰς πύλας. — Aperīmus/solvimus portās. (1ª pl.)
βούλονται λύειν. — Volunt solvere. (īnfīnītīvus post verbum auxiliāre)
οἱ πολῖται λύουσι τὸν νόμον; — Num cīvēs legem solvunt/abrogant? (3ª pl., interrogātiō)
τί λύεις; — Quid solvis? (2ª sg., interrogātiō)

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere prōnōmen subiectī (ἐγώ, σύ...) necessārium esse ante omne verbum, imitandō linguās Rōmānicās/Anglicam.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī dēsinentia ipsa indicat persōnam; prōnōmen omittitur nisi ēmphasis quaerātur, sīcut cum εἰμί (Gradū I).
commonMistakes.why: Verba Graeca, sīcut Latīna, sunt linguae “pro-drop” — persōna inest morphologiae verbī ipsīus.

commonMistakes.wrong: Cōnfundere fōrmam citātiōnis dictiōnāriī (λύω, 1ª persōna sg.) cum īnfīnītīvō (λύειν), quaerendō “λύειν” in dictiōnāriīs.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī dictiōnāria Graeca citant verba per fōrmam -ω (1ª persōna praesentis āctīvī), nōn per īnfīnītīvum.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen ā convention linguārum modernārum (et etiam Latīnārum, quae saepe citant per īnfīnītīvum) creat cōnfūsiōnem regulārem apud incipientēs.

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre dēsinentiam -ουσι(ν) tantum cum sequitur pausa vel vōcālis, neglegendō ν in cēterīs contextibus, vel semper omittendō ν.
commonMistakes.right: Applicāre ν ephelkystikon secundum rēgulam iam discitam (Gradū I): ante vōcālem sequentem vel in fine sententiae/clausulae.
commonMistakes.why: Rēgula est identica omnibus fōrmīs verbālibus fīnītīs -σι, nōn tantum fōrmīs verbī εἰμί.

exercises.title: Ἡ Ἀπορία τοῦ Ἀγάθωνος
exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.
exercises.passage: Ἀγάθων ἀπορίαν ἔχει. Μελίτη λέγει· “Τί λύεις;” Ἀγάθων λέγει· “Ὁ διδάσκαλος λύει τὴν ἀπορίαν.” “Ἡμεῖς λύομεν τὰς πύλας,” λέγει Μελίτη. “Καὶ οἱ πολῖται βούλονται λύειν τὸν νόμον.”

items.explanation: Ἀγάθων ἀπορίαν ἔχει.
“Ὁ διδάσκαλος λύει τὴν ἀπορίαν.”

items.prompt: Quid Melitē et Agathōn portīs faciunt?
items.explanation: “Ἡμεῖς λύομεν τὰς πύλας.”
“Οἱ πολῖται βούλονται λύειν τὸν νόμον.”

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine persōnae.

items.statement: “Τί λύεις;” — Melitē rogat quid Ἀγάθων faciat.
items.explanation: Λύεις (2ª persōna) refert ad Ἀγάθωνα, ad quem Melitē loquitur.

items.statement: “Ὁ διδάσκαλος λύει τὴν ἀπορίαν” — Ἀγάθων ipse solvit quaestiōnem.
items.explanation: Falsum: λύει (3ª persōna) refert ad ὁ διδάσκαλος (magister), nōn ad Ἀγάθωνα ipsum.

items.statement: “Ἡμεῖς λύομεν τὰς πύλας” — sōla Melitē portās aperit.
items.explanation: Falsum: λύομεν (1ª persōna plūrālis) significat “nōs”, id est Ἀγάθων ET Melitē simul.

items.statement: Cīvēs, secundum Melitēn, volunt lēgem solvere/abrogāre, nōn servāre.
items.explanation: “Βούλονται λύειν τὸν νόμον” — λύειν hīc significat “solvere/abrogāre”, nōn “servāre”.

exercises.title: Coniugā λύω
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā verbī λύω.

items.explanation: Prīma persōna singulāris: λύω.
Secunda persōna singulāris: λύεις.
Tertia persōna singulāris: λύει.
Prīma persōna plūrālis: λύομεν.
Tertia persōna plūrālis: λύουσι(ν).

items.prompt: Quā fōrmā dictiōnāria Graeca citant verba?
options: prīmā persōnā singulārī praesentis āctīvī (ut λύω)
items.explanation: Discrīmen ā convention Latīnā/modernā: Graecum citat per -ω, nōn per īnfīnītīvum.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma īnfīnītīvī praesentis āctīvī verbī λύω?
items.explanation: Īnfīnītīvus praesēns āctīvus fīnītur -ειν.
Thema est pars invariābilis verbī, cui dēsinentiae persōnālēs adiunguntur.

items.prompt: Estne prōnōmen subiectī necessārium ante λύω, λύεις, etc.?
items.explanation: Graecum est lingua pro-drop; prōnōmen adhibētur sōlum prō ēmphasī.

items.prompt: Quandō adhibētur ν ephelkystikon in λύουσι(ν)?
options: numquam in verbīs, sōlum in εἰμί
ante vōcālem sequentem vel in fine clausulae
items.explanation: Rēgula est generālis, applicāta ad omnem fōrmam fīnītam -σι, nōn tantum εἰμί.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Fōrma λύετε est secunda persōna plūrālis.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: -ετε est dēsinentia secundae persōnae plūrālis.

items.statement: Verba Graeca in -ω requīrunt semper prōnōmen subiectī explicitum.
items.explanation: Falsum: dēsinentia ipsa indicat persōnam; prōnōmen est optiōnāle, prō ēmphasī.
Corrēctum: λύειν est īnfīnītīvus praesēns āctīvus regulāris.

items.statement: Dictiōnāria Graeca citant verba per fōrmam īnfīnītīvī, sīcut Anglica/Lūsitānica.
items.explanation: Falsum: citant per prīmam persōnam singulārem praesentis āctīvī (-ω).

summary: Praesēns indicātīvum āctīvum λύω: λύω, λύεις, λύει // λύομεν, λύετε, λύουσι(ν).
Verbum Graecum indicat persōnam per dēsinentiam; prōnōmen subiectī plērumque omittitur.
Dictiōnāria citant verba per 1ª persōnam singulārem praesentis āctīvī (-ω), nōn per īnfīnītīvum — discrīmen ā convention Latīnā/modernā.
Ν ephelkystikon valet etiam in 3ª persōnā plūrālī verbōrum (λύουσιν), sequēns eandem rēgulam ex Gradū I.
